hero.heading: Growth marketing, run like a business — because we've run one
hero.description: We started Benvor Digital because too many agencies sell activity instead of outcomes. We built ours around the opposite idea.

story.image_alt: Benvor Digital strategists reviewing campaign performance on a whiteboard
story.story_paragraph_1: Benvor Digital was founded by a small team of in‑house marketers who kept getting pulled into agency reviews for the wrong reasons — vague reporting, generic strategy decks, and campaigns that looked busy but didn't move revenue. We built the agency we wished we'd had: one that treats every client's budget like it's coming out of our own pocket.
story.story_paragraph_2: Today we work with local shops opening their first location and global brands running campaigns across a dozen markets. The size changes. The standard doesn't.
story.mission_text: To make sophisticated, ROI‑driven marketing accessible to businesses of every size — not just the ones with enterprise budgets and in‑house data teams.
differences: One team handles strategy, design, and media — nothing gets lost in a handoff between departments.
You get access to the same live dashboard we use internally, not a curated monthly summary.
Every contract is quarter‑to‑quarter. We keep clients with results, not paperwork.
We say no to channels that won't work for your business, even if it means a smaller invoice.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: Real numbers, shared in real time. No metric gets dressed up to look better than it is.

items.title: Craft
items.description: Design and copy that respect the visitor's attention, not just the algorithm.

items.title: Accountability
items.description: We set targets before a project starts and report against them, publicly, throughout.

items.title: Speed
items.description: Campaigns launch in days, not months. Momentum compounds — so we protect it.

cta.heading: Want to know if we're the right fit?
cta.description: A 30‑minute call will tell you. No pitch deck required.
